notes.title: ver2.0 Update Information
notes.notes:
ver2.0
Version updated.

Fever time behavior has been changed.
Previously, everyone had a constant speed, but now it has been changed to current speed +30.
Additionally, click boost is now applied.

Monster specifications have been changed.
Monsters are now placed every 10km.
If not defeated within 60 seconds, you will be sent back 9km.
If sent back, the value of the "Total Distance Pioneered" achievement will not increase until the boss is defeated.
In the monster area, three monsters are placed.
As a result, the required amounts for the "Total Monsters Defeated" and "Weekly 3" achievements have been increased.

Added facility enhancement items.
Facility skills can now be enhanced when specific blueprints are obtained at the base camp.
Enhancements require Pioneering Power and Coins.

Horse Stable Skill "Fast Horse" in Facility Enhancements
When a monster is defeated, there is a chance to skip 10% of the "Highest Reached Distance."
As the level increases, the activation rate improves.
The skill activates up to 90% of the "Highest Reached Distance."

Added Achievement "Fairy Touch"
Counts when you touch a fairy.
The reward increases the amount of time gained during fever time when clicking fairies after completing daily quests by 1 second.
Base value: 10 seconds + Lv.

Added Achievement "Weekly Quest Complete"
Counts when all weekly quests are cleared, and you return to the base.
Increases pioneering power gained from clicks.
Pioneering power gained from clicks × (Lv+1).
Counting starts after the version update.

Other Changes and Fixes
The calculation methods for Mining Power, Logging Power, Material HP, and Monster HP have been changed. As a result, the numbers are now 100 times higher than before.
Click boost is now applied to attack power (Logging Power + Mining Power) against enemies.
Stamina consumption now only decreases when gathering or attacking.
The achievement for "Total Distance Pioneered" was locked at Lv31, but now it has no limit.
The calculation for character level-up multipliers (10x and 100x) was not functioning properly, so it has been temporarily removed.
Achievement information alignment has been shifted to the left. However, some descriptions are still truncated depending on the language.

About ver2.0
With the facility skill "Swift Horse" and the adjustment of Fever Time speed, it should now be easier to return to the highest reached point after going back to the base.
Facility upgrades at the base camp significantly increase the amount of wood and stone acquired, so the difficulty of leveling up despite having blueprints should be somewhat alleviated.
There may still be balance issues, so any comments or feedback would be appreciated.
